summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend verification of the 4 SkillMatch enhancements plus MIT-WPU image swap. All 6 pytest cases pass (profile edit auth + persistence, event create/edit/delete + ownership 403 + 404, checkin_code hidden from volunteers, full QR check-in flow + PDF cert content starts with %PDF, cert 404 for non-completed and unknown events). Playwright run through full UI: login as organizer sees edit/delete/QR icon buttons on their events, QR modal shows qr-code-box and 6-char checkin code, Edit modal prefills existing title. Volunteer never sees edit/qr/delete icons. Profile modal opens from both nav-profile-button and open-profile-button, saves via PATCH /api/auth/me and shows 'Profile updated.' toast. MIT-WPU dome image loads on both .auth-image and .hero-visual.
critical_code_review_comments: event_payload leaks `checkin_code` only to owner-organizer (verified good). Keep in mind: if ever an organizer queries another organizer's events, code is already hidden - good.
POST /api/events/{id}/apply allows applying to an event already marked status='completed' (event-wide status). Minor UX gap; main agent may want to block applications after event-level completion.
server.py is now ~430 lines; still manageable but approaching the point where routers (auth/events/certs) should be split into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own TEST_ prefixed events. event-python has been left in 'completed' status by prior iterations (expected regression artifact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 enhancements verified end-to-end on live preview URL. Backend test module /app/backend/tests/test_enhancements.py is the authoritative regression suite for the new endpoints (PATCH /api/auth/me, PATCH/DELETE /api/events/{id}, POST /api/events/{id}/checkin, GET /api/certificates/{id} PDF). Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_skillmatch_api.py still works except that event-python is persistently 'completed' in remote mongo - the certificate 404 assertion there is stale (noted in iteration_3). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env variable before running pytest.
